title: Legal Consequences of the Separation of the Chagos Archipelago from Mauritius in 1965 (Advisory Opinion)
publisher_or_archive: International Court of Justice, The Hague
summary: Landmark advisory opinion delivered by the International Court of Justice finding by 13 votes to 1 that the UK's detachment of the Chagos Archipelago and forced expulsion of its population prior to Mauritian independence was an unlawful act that violated the right to self-determination, and ruling that the UK is under an obligation to bring an end to its administration of the Chagos Archipelago as rapidly as possible.
